beats.summary: {PROTAGONIST} climbs onto {ANTAGONIST} in the half-dark, establishing the intimate, threshold-like atmosphere.

{PROTAGONIST} lowers herself onto {ANTAGONIST}, comparing the experience to an empty room being filled.
{PROTAGONIST} uses her hair as a curtain, allowing {ANTAGONIST} to observe her breathing.

{ANTAGONIST} feels the muscle work, and {PROTAGONIST} laughs, finding pleasure in the held moment.

{ANTAGONIST} completes the experience, and {PROTAGONIST} remains anchored to the connection.
